# 1 Clement Chapter 64 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 64

---

## Council Notes

**On "peculiar people" / "special people" / "own special people" (v.1):** EMET: "peculiar people." LOGOS: "special people." PNEUMA: "own special people." The Greek *periousion laon* (from *periousios*) is the LXX rendering of the Hebrew *am segullah* (treasure/possession people, Ex 19:5). "Peculiar people" is the KJV rendering; "special people" (LOGOS) or "people of his own possession" would be more modern. "His own special people" (PNEUMA) is acceptable. The established theological term "peculiar people" is preserved as it is Clement's deliberate allusion to the covenant election formula.

**On the virtue list (v.1):** Seven virtues: faith, fear, peace, longsuffering, self-control, purity, sobriety. All agents agree. The number seven may be deliberate. The list should be preserved in full.

**On "Guardian" / "Champion" / "Protector" (v.1):** EMET: "Guardian." LOGOS: "Champion." PNEUMA: "Protector." The Greek here is *archiereus* (High Priest) and *prostatēs* (guardian/advocate/champion). In Ch.61 SOPHIA ruled "Advocate" for *prostasia* in the genitive; here the nominative *prostatēs* has a slightly different valence. "Guardian" (EMET) is retained as consistent with its use in the letter.

**On doxological formula (v.1):** LOGOS adds "for evermore and" creating a doubled formula. EMET/PNEUMA have the simpler form. The Greek *nun kai eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn* = "now and unto the ages of the ages." EMET's rendering is preferred.

---

**64:1** Now may the God of all things, who sees everything, who is the Ruler of all spirits and the Lord of all flesh, who chose the Lord Jesus Christ and us through him to be a peculiar people — may he grant to every soul that is called by his magnificent and holy name: faith, fear, peace, longsuffering, self-control, purity, and sobriety, that they may be found well-pleasing to his name, through our High Priest and Guardian Jesus Christ, through whom be glory and majesty, might and honor to him, both now and for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*— SOPHIA*
